summary: The title screen is now the Halcyon menu: your own picture as the background, flat Halcyon buttons, a wordmark header and a live message from the backend. The badge now always decorates your own name, so it is visible on the tab screen without any configuration, and it can no longer stack up in front of a name. A dependency free backend service for roster, presence and branding ships in server/ with a one command install for Ubuntu 24.04.
